claims.claim: These 2 books are perfect combo for intentional people, who don't just want to be at the top but...
claims.evidence: The witness report only describes the book covers/titles/authors; it does not confirm condition, completeness, or any other factual details implied by the seller.

risks.risk: Inside-page condition may be poor (missing pages, tears, heavy highlighting/writing).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the first 5–10 pages and a random middle page showing any writing/highlights/tears.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with unknown internal condition (worst-case: possible writing/tears/missing pages).

risks.risk: Hardback vs paperback affects value and durability.
risks.proof: A photo showing the book spine and thickness, or a side view of the pages/cover edge.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end assuming paperback/less durable format.

risks.risk: Edition/year/ISBN may differ; some editions are more valuable or easier to resell.
risks.proof: A photo of the copyright page showing edition/year and ISBN.
risks.if_unproven: Price without edition premium (treat as generic used copies).

risks.risk: Cover wear not visible in the photos (creases, fading, water damage) could reduce value.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all corners and edges of both covers (front and back).
risks.if_unproven: Price as if there may be minor wear beyond what the cover view shows.

risks.risk: Completeness issues (missing dust jacket for hardbacks, missing pages not visible from cover).
risks.proof: Photo of the back cover and, if hardback, the dust jacket (or confirmation it’s not present).
risks.if_unproven: Price as complete only for what’s visible; assume worst-case missing extras.

proof_requests: Send photos of the inside pages: first pages, a random middle page, and the last pages (showing any writing/highlights/tears).
Confirm hardback or paperback with a spine/side thickness photo.
Send a photo of the copyright/ISBN page for each book.
Send close-ups of front/back cover corners and edges for both books.
If hardback, show whether a dust jacket is present; if not, confirm.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the two specific books by cover (titles/authors) and shows the covers intact and readable; internal condition and format are unknown, so pricing should assume the worst-case used condition until proof is provided.
